Dear Customer,

Thank you for contacting us.

We appreciate the detailed troubleshooting that you have already performed. We understand that the station is still not emptying the dirty water even after you cleaned it and checked the hose and connector.

For the X10 Pro Omni T2351, our station sewage-pumping guidance covers this symptom. Since you have already cleaned the tray, checked the hose, and confirmed that the connector and dirty water tank are not the issue, the next checks are the dirty water tank latch/lid pressure and the sealing ring.

Please ensure that the dirty water tank is seated with its door latch fastened, then press down on the tank lid and start a mop-pad wash from the app. If dirty water still does not pump out, check the sealing ring for any local collapse and pull the collapsed area outward until it is flush. After that, please let me know whether dirty water pumps out once the lid is pressed. [2]

Anker Support Team

Hello,

Thank you for contacting us.

I’m sorry to hear about the charging pin issue, and I really appreciate you describing it in detail. I can understand why a case that only charges on one side is frustrating, especially after you’ve kept it clean and dry.

For the S1 Pro charging case (T8D04), our reference material lists one-side charging failure as possibly coming from a poor or incompatible cable, debris on the magnetic contacts, or a misaligned charging pin. It also includes a cross-test: placing the other pump in this case, or this pump in a working case, helps show whether the case or the pump side is affected. I don't have any order or purchase details on file for you, so I can't confirm warranty coverage from this message alone.

If the pin looks bent rather than broken, you could gently try realigning it and reseating the pump until the case indicator flashes white. So I can request a manual review of your warranty options, could you share your proof of purchase, such as an order number or receipt? [2] [3]

Anker Support Team
